description: Manages user profile information, including personal details, contact information, roles, permissions, and preferences within the system.

endpoints.name: UpdateProfile
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's profile information, such as name, contact details, and other personal attributes. This operation allows users to modify their own profile data.

profile.description: Updated profile model containing new information

example_uses: How do I change my profile details?
I need to update my contact information.
Can you help me modify my user profile?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the authenticated user needs to update their personal profile information, such as name, address, phone number, or other details stored in their profile.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserInfo
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's information and profile settings. This includes general user data and potentially broader settings beyond just personal profile details.

userInfo.description: Updated user information object containing profile changes

example_uses: I want to change my user settings.
How can I update my general user information?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when the authenticated user needs to update their general user information or settings that might encompass more than just basic profile details, such as preferences or other user-specific configurations.

endpoints.name: GetUserProfileDetails
endpoints.description: Retrieves comprehensive current user information including profile, roles, permissions, organizational settings, and user preferences. This endpoint can also be used by administrators to fetch details for a specific user by providing their email.

email.description: Optional specific email to get user info for (if not provided, uses current authenticated user)

example_uses: Show me my current profile details.
What are my roles and permissions?
Can I see the profile for user@example.com?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve all available information about the current authenticated user, including their profile, assigned roles, permissions, and organizational context. It can also be used by authorized personnel to look up another user's details by providing their email address.
